newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Perdana to buy 51 pct stake in bank.
newsitem.headline: Perdana to buy 51 pct stake in bank.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Perdana Cipta Multi Finance will purchase a 51 percent stake in a domestic bank as part of its plan to become a financial services holding company, the Bisnis Indonesia daily reported on Thursday.

The paper quoted Perdana Cipta's President Director Hasan Krisno as saying the company's planned restructuring was subject to shareholder approval at its ordinary general meeting at the end of November.
It gave no details on the identity of the bank it planned to purchase.
The paper quoted its sources as saying the new holding company would include four divisions including finance, banking, the stock market and insurance.
